status: MEASURED fixed-resolution two-module civilian clearance workload; combined release benchmark remains separate
scope: Matched 60 simulation-second fixed1280x800 lower public loop through native RAF, standard simulated controller and rendering. Matched player input/camera positions; final body composition can change the visible scene. No combat/replay/destruction stress; not final combined release acceptance.

gpuTiming.scope: Asynchronous elapsed GPU time for renderNight, including world, cartridge capture and post pass
